Subject: Supplier onboarding: SwiftOps — PO requirement?

Folks,

SwiftOps (contact: Tracey) is asking to start a 6-week pilot next week. They want to invoice after completion (Net-30) and are pushing to onboard without a PO for speed. I attached their onboarding questionnaire and a draft SOW.

Questions:
- Do we have flexibility to allow a temporary "no-PO" exception for pilots under $20k?
- If yes, what approvals & controls do we need so finance stays comfortable? (accounting code, invoice routing, cap, signed SOW, W9/insurance)

Ben/Marissa — can you advise procurement/ops path? Laura, tagging you for finance sign-off if an exception is needed.

Thanks,
Nikhil

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: SwiftOps — PO requirement?

On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 9:12 AM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com> wrote:
> SwiftOps (contact: Tracey) is asking to start a 6-week pilot next week. They want to invoice after completion (Net-30) and are pushing to onboard without a PO for speed.
>
> Do we have flexibility to allow a temporary "no-PO" exception for pilots under $20k?

Short answer: yes, with guardrails. Current procurement policy is PO-required for all vendor spend; exceptions are granted rarely. For trials/pilots we've allowed a limited "PO-waiver" where finance issues a waiver ticket and we apply these controls:
- Pre-approval by Finance (Laura) and Revenue Ops (Marissa)
- Cap on total invoice amount (we usually set $10k–$25k depending on risk)
- Vendor must supply W9, COI (insurance), and signed SOW
- Invoices routed to procurements@redwood.com with the waiver ticket number in the subject
- Accounting code and cost center provided up-front

For SwiftOps specifically I propose: cap $15,000; waiver ticket; we store documents in Drive under vendor record (link). If Laura signs off, operations will run onboarding paperwork and we can start.

I attached a fillable "no_po_exception-form" we use.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Ben / Nikhil —

I'm okay approving a temporary PO-waiver for SwiftOps with the following mandatory conditions:
1) Maximum total pilot invoicing: $15,000; any change requires re-approval.
2) We must receive W9 and COI before the pilot starts. If COI is delayed, no work commences.
3) Signed SOW (DocuSign) on file and stored in Drive under vendor ID SwiftOps-2026-11.
4) Invoice must include waiver ticket ID and accounting code; routing: procurements@redwood.com, finance@redwood.com.
5) Procurement to create a waiver ticket in Jira (PRC-5479) and link to vendor record.

If those are met, finance will authorize the waiver. Marissa — please create the ticket and confirm storage location. Ben/Nikhil — confirm you have vendor docs coming (W9/COI/SOW).
